<div id="readme" class="md" data-path="README.md"><article class="markdown-body entry-content container-lg" itemprop="text"><div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h1 class="heading-element" dir="auto">PlutoPlotly.jl</h1><a id="user-content-plutoplotlyjl" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: PlutoPlotly.jl" href="#plutoplotlyjl"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto"><a href="https://github.com/JuliaPluto/PlutoPlotly.jl/actions/workflows/CI.yml?query=branch%3Amain"><img src="https://github.com/JuliaPluto/PlutoPlotly.jl/actions/workflows/CI.yml/badge.svg?branch=main" alt="Build Status" style="max-width: 100%;"></a>
<a href="https://codecov.io/gh/JuliaPluto/PlutoPlotly.jl" rel="nofollow"><img src="https://camo.githubusercontent.com/c4f983b24cf39393b5c0b9567dafb5e59298d3a6670cbd18bb80362843e74c51/68747470733a2f2f636f6465636f762e696f2f67682f4a756c6961506c75746f2f506c75746f506c6f746c792e6a6c2f6272616e63682f6d61696e2f67726170682f62616467652e737667" alt="Coverage" data-canonical-src="https://codecov.io/gh/JuliaPluto/PlutoPlotly.jl/branch/main/graph/badge.svg" style="max-width: 100%;"></a>
<a href="https://github.com/JuliaTesting/Aqua.jl"><img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JuliaTesting/Aqua.jl/master/badge.svg" alt="Aqua QA" style="max-width: 100%;"></a></p>
<p dir="auto">This package provides a wrapper type <code>PlutoPlot</code> around the <code>Plot</code> type from <a href="https://github.com/sglyon/PlotlyBase.jl">PlotlyBase.jl</a> that exposes the <a href="https://plotly.com/julia/" rel="nofollow">plotly library</a>.</p>
<p dir="auto">The wrapper mostly defines a custom <code>show</code> method specifically optimized for displaying inside of <a href="https://github.com/fonsp/Pluto.jl/">Pluto.jl</a> and adds the options of providing custom javascript functions to attach to the <a href="https://plotly.com/javascript/plotlyjs-events/" rel="nofollow">plolty JS events</a></p>
<p dir="auto">You can load the PlutoPlotly package <em>instead of</em> PlotlyBase or PlotlyJS, and replace <code>Plot</code> with <code>plot</code> from PlutoPlotly. For example:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-julia notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="plot([5,6,7,2]; line_color=&quot;red&quot;)"><pre><span class="pl-c1">plot</span>([<span class="pl-c1">5</span>,<span class="pl-c1">6</span>,<span class="pl-c1">7</span>,<span class="pl-c1">2</span>]; line_color<span class="pl-k">=</span><span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>red<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span>)</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">You can also create a PlotlyBase <code>Plot</code>, and then wrap it inside a <code>PlutoPlot</code> object:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-julia notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="let
    # create a PlotlyBase function
    p = Plot(args...)
    # wrap it
    PlutoPlot(p)
end"><pre><span class="pl-k">let</span>
    <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> create a PlotlyBase function</span>
    p <span class="pl-k">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">Plot</span>(args<span class="pl-k">...</span>)
    <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> wrap it</span>
    <span class="pl-c1">PlutoPlot</span>(p)
<span class="pl-k">end</span></pre></div>
<p dir="auto">(The function <code>plot(args...)</code> from PlutoPlotly is the same as <code>PlutoPlot(Plot(args...))</code>.)</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h1 class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h1><a id="user-content-features" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 class="heading-element" dir="auto">Persistent Layout</h2><a id="user-content-persistent-layout" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Persistent Layout" href="#persistent-layout"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The custom show method relies on the <a href="https://plotly.com/javascript/plotlyjs-function-reference/#plotlyreact" rel="nofollow"><code>Plotly.react</code></a> function, which is optimized for updating or re-plotting data on an existing graph object, making it ideal in combination with Pluto's reactivity. The data transfer between Pluto and the browser also exploits Pluto's own <code>publish_to_js</code> function which is usually faster than standard JSON serialization, especially for big datasets.</p>
<p dir="auto">One advantage of using <code>react</code> as opposed to <code>newPlot</code> from the Plotly library is that one can have the layout (e.g. zoom level, camera view angle, etc...) persist across reactive re-runs by exploiting the <a href="https://plotly.com/javascript/uirevision/" rel="nofollow"><code>uirevision</code></a> attribute of Plotly layouts:</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 class="heading-element" dir="auto">Return values to Julia using @bind</h2><a id="user-content-return-values-to-julia-using-bind" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Return values to Julia using @bind" href="#return-values-to-julia-using-bind"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">The possibility of attaching event listeners to the plotly events allows to create nice interactivity between Julia and Pluto using the <code>@bind</code> macro</p>
